note: Shrink-only ceilings for the six debt metrics. Lower is always accepted; raising one fails the guard. defer_async is informational adoption, not gated.
stated_budget_note: Target from issue #2495 (Lighthouse, compressed, 390px). This guard counts uncompressed local bytes only and does not enforce the compressed figures.

metric_notes.js_bytes: uncompressed on-disk bytes of local script srcs
metric_notes.css_bytes: uncompressed on-disk bytes of local stylesheet hrefs
metric_notes.blocking_script_src: script_src tags with no defer/async (gated budget)
metric_notes.defer_async: script tags with defer/async (adoption; higher is better)
